verdict.rationale: Angular's own docs position it for applications that scale with team size. They point to Signals-based fine-grained reactivity, opinionated components with dependency injection, integrated first-party modules and a style guide. Community reports corroborate strong performance (AOT compilation, tree-shaking, fast rendering) and enterprise-friendly structure; the digest-cycle scaling complaints concern legacy AngularJS, not current Angular. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of large-app performance techniques (e.g. lazy loading or change-detection tuning), and recent independent or hands-on evidence of modern Angular at large codebase/team scale.
